pages.text: Allah the Exalted says: ﴿وَإِذۡ جَعَلۡنَا ٱلۡبَيۡتَ مَثَابَةٗ لِّلنَّاسِ وَأَمۡنٗا﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'And when We made the House a place people return to, and a place of safety.' That is: Allah made the Kaaba a place people come to, go back to their families, and come to again, and a place of safety where no enemy attacks them.

Ibrahim (peace be upon him) prayed to his Lord to make this land safe from fear, and to provide its people with all kinds of fruits. He asked this provision especially for those of them who believe in Allah and the Last Day.

Ibrahim and Isma'il raised the foundations of the Kaaba, praying to Allah with humility: ﴿رَبَّنَا تَقَبَّلۡ مِنَّآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلسَّمِيعُ ٱلۡعَلِيمُ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Our Lord, accept from us; You are the All-Hearing, the All-Knowing.' And Allah commanded that the Station of Ibrahim be taken as a place of prayer: it is the stone Ibrahim stood on while he built the Kaaba.

Allah revealed to Ibrahim and his son Isma'il to purify His House from every impurity, for those who circle it, those who stay in it for worship, and those who pray. It is a House people come to for circling and prayer, and where they gather for Hajj and Umrah.

And they prayed to their Lord: ﴿رَبَّنَا وَٱجۡعَلۡنَا مُسۡلِمَيۡنِ لَكَ وَمِن ذُرِّيَّتِنَآ أُمَّةٗ مُّسۡلِمَةٗ لَّكَ وَأَرِنَا مَنَاسِكَنَا وَتُبۡ عَلَيۡنَآۖ إِنَّكَ أَنتَ ٱلتَّوَّابُ ٱلرَّحِيمُ﴾ — interpretation of the meaning: 'Our Lord, make us submit to You, and make of our descendants a nation submitting to You, show us our ways of worship, and accept our repentance; You are the One who accepts repentance, the Most Merciful.' Its meaning in al-Muyassar: that Allah keep them firm in Islam, make of their descendants a nation that obeys Him, show them the ways of His worship, and forgive their sins.

Among the lessons of these verses: Ibrahim and Isma'il worked and prayed to Allah to accept their work from them. They prayed for their descendants, and asked Allah to send among them a messenger from among them who would recite His verses to them, teach them and purify them. And the House is a place of safety and prayer, which Allah made a place people return to.
